name: Bitwarden
description: Bitwarden is an open-source, end-to-end encrypted password manager described by the vendor as "the most trusted password manager," securing passwords, passkeys, and secrets for people, AI agents, and machines.
best_for: The vendor states millions of users choose it to protect themselves and their families, alongside businesses and development/DevOps teams needing secrets management.
features: Secure Send for sharing sensitive info

alternatives.name: 1Password
alternatives.description: A unified vault for identities, credentials, and secrets aimed at enterprise access management.
alternatives.best_for: Organizations wanting integrated privileged access and SaaS governance alongside password management.

alternatives.name: LastPass
alternatives.description: A zero-knowledge password manager with family and business plans.
alternatives.best_for: Individuals and families wanting a straightforward vault with dark web monitoring.
